name: notes-app
description: CozyNotes is a modern, charming, and interactive web-based daily journal and note-taking planner designed to transform productivity into a comforting and delightful ritual. Built with modern web development standards, the application leverages Webpack as a module bundler, native Web Components for encapsulated UI elements, and asynchronous RESTful API integration with the Dicoding Notes API v2 for reliable cloud synchronization. Featuring a warm pastel aesthetic with Google Fonts (Fredoka and Quicksand), responsive CSS Grid layouts, and cheerful micro-animations, CozyNotes elevates personal organization with a daily mood tracker, digital sticker annotations, washi-tape pinned notes, and interactive daily checklists with celebratory particle effects. To foster a peaceful creative environment, the app includes a real-time Web Audio API ambient soundscape generator with melodious songbirds, gentle garden breeze, and soothing chimes. Users can effortlessly create, search, read full notes via an intuitive detail modal, edit, archive, and delete notes with real-time feedback and SweetAlert2 indicators, delivering a harmonious blend of technical rigor, accessibility, and playful user experience.
